Hannah: Kickoff for Wellmark Health onboarding. Goal: pilot 3 clinics in 60 days, full rollout in 120. Need owners, key success criteria, and immediate blockers. Main risks: SSO timeline, dataset mapping, clinician scheduling.
Mikael: I'm the Wellmark PM (Mikael). Internal owners: Lina (IT), Arjun (Data), Dr. Kim (Clinical). Data residency: US-east per contract.
Hannah: Thanks. Proposed milestones: Week 1: staging access + sample data; Week 2-3: mapping + validation; Week 4-6: pilot; Week 7-12: iterate + scale. Go/no-go at end of Week 3.
Rae: SE here  will need a 100-row NDJSON masked sample and expected avg note size. If notes >8KB we'll recommend chunking and async ingest. Also please provide auth method for staging.
Owen: Infra/security note  SAML SSO + SCIM preferred. Security intake ETA 7 business days after docs. If SSO blocks, we can provision scoped invites for pilot users to avoid delay. Also request SOC2 summary.
Priya: I'll run enablement. Proposed training: 60-min clinician workshop + 30-min office hours twice during pilot. Success metrics suggestion: median task completion <140s, ingest error rate <0.6%, pilot clinician adoption >=70% by week 4. Renewal risk triggers: adoption <45% or >2 P1s/week.
Mikael: Agreed. We'll capture feedback via weekly 15-min interviews + an in-app 2-question pulse. I'll send clinician roster by EOD Tue.
Hannah: Action items recap: 1) Mikael to provide sample dataset + roster + SOC2 excerpt (due 2026-10-05). 2) Rae to prepare integration doc + chunking guidance (due 2026-10-07). 3) Owen/security to start intake once docs arrive (ETA 7bd). 4) Priya to draft enablement materials and survey (draft due 2026-10-08). 5) Hannah to publish kickoff playbook and schedule weekly ops standups.
Hannah: @OnboardBot create task "Wellmark pilot dataset + mapping" assign: Mikael, Rae due: 2026-10-05.
OnboardBot: Task created: "Wellmark pilot dataset + mapping" assigned to Mikael, Rae. Due 2026-10-05.
Rae: Sending sample format spec in a sec. Quick note: recommend tokenization at ingest to reduce compute if notes are verbose.
Priya: I'll prepare a 1-page clinician quick-reference and record the workshop for those who can't attend. Will post draft in #cs-ops by Thu.
Hannah: Next check-in: Mon 2026-10-04 09:00 PT. Any blockers before then?
Mikael: Contract/legal is pulling SOC2 excerpt now. If SSO timelines slip I'll flag immediately. Thanks team. :rocket:
